t: 在波萨达战役中,瓦拉几亚的巴萨拉一世击败了查理一世·罗伯特的匈牙利军队.
te: At the Battle of Posada, Basarab I of Wallachia defeats the Hungarian army of Charles I Robert.
dz: 在波萨达战役中,瓦拉几亚的巴萨拉一世击败了查理一世·罗伯特的匈牙利军队.
de: At the Battle of Posada, Basarab I of Wallachia defeats the Hungarian army of Charles I Robert.

t: 瓦拉奇安·沃伊沃德·巴萨拉b 我通过伏击打败了匈牙利军队.
te: Wallachian Voievode Basarab I defeats the Hungarian army by ambush.
dz: 波萨达战役结束:瓦拉奇安·沃伊沃德·巴萨拉b 我通过伏击打败了匈牙利军队.
de: Battle of Posada ends: Wallachian Voievode Basarab I defeats the Hungarian army by ambush.
